mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear morning at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 52 degrees.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is currently accepting applications for its free nine-week Citizen Academy program, which kicks off on September 23rd. Additionally, the city has posted official notices for the upcoming November 3rd general election.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival taking place today. You can also catch live music at Baileys Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout the day today. Tomorrow, you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness.

Regarding local law enforcement, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary in progress. One suspect, 19 year old Luis Aragon-Zaring, was taken into custody following the incident.
Today's featured flavor at the Verona Culver's is Really Reese's. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit accordingly to enjoy your treat.
